summary: WebBrowser consumes Audio.Core directly and does not depend on native Host/Engine/OpenAL. Its pure policy starts Locked, emits CreateOrResumeContext from RequestUnlock and enters Running only on UnlockSucceeded. It tracks asset decode status, bounds one-shot voices by retiring the oldest at capacity, rejects locked/paused/disposed dispatch and owns stop/close effects. The graph host mechanically applies those effects through Fable DOM bindings. The packed-candidate browser workflow runs Chromium, Firefox and WebKit; owning acceptance explicitly limits automated evidence to graph state/lifecycle and leaves audibility to manual listening. A green policy/browser check does not prove human audibility, installed downstream adoption or native OpenAL behavior.
title: Web Audio is gesture gated and outside the native Engine closure
